name: Bela (Edomite king)
title: The first king of Edom
summary: Bela, son of Beor, was the first king to reign in Edom, with the city of Dinhabah as his capital. He is mentioned first in the list of Edomite kings.

keyEvents.title: First king of Edom
keyEvents.description: Bela, son of Beor, was the first king to reign in Edom.
